requirement: The system should be able to sell open-dated tickets for attractions.

The system should be able to sell dated tickets for attractions that allow access only for selected dates by guest. Special day tickets should also be supported. These are dated tickets that skip date selection by guests and only allow access on a designated day or date.

The system should be able to sell time-slot based tickets for attractions. The system should support:
- Creation of timeslots for a whole day or for a period 
- Configuration of capacity for each timeslot. Capacity can also be set as unlimited or defined capacity
- Ability to setup timeslots dynamically based on customer demand.
- Definition of frequency of the slots (e.g. every thirty minutes, every hour, whole day)
- Selection of precise time of entry (e.g. entry at 3.30 pm) or not (e.g. entry allowed between 2 and 4 pm) 
- Ability to setpu pre and post buffer time based on the performance start date and time. Example. Tickets are allowed to scan 30 minutes from the performance start date and time and untill 2 hours of the start time or till EOD.
- Ability to copy and paste performance for a different date

The system should provide an easy-to-use interface for creation and configuration of timeslots. A calendar view should be available for the user to define the timeslot and recurrence rules. The user should be able to:
1) Specify the frequency and days of timeslot recurrence
2) Specify the total number of occurrences 
3) Clone and delete occurrences
The system should be able to sell multiple day tickets for attractions. The number of days should be configurable. This type of ticket should require a start date to be specified before first entry.
The system should be able to sell membership passes for an attraction (e.g. annual pass, monthly pass) for configurable duration.
The system should be able to sell camp tickets. Such tickets should have configuration to allow access for X day(s) of the week for Y weeks.
The system should be able to sell add-on items for all type of tickets. Add-ons can also be configured as a stand-alone product and able to be purchased on their own.

The system should allow the validity period for a ticket to be configurable. For open-dated tickets, the validity period is intended to define the mandatory date by which the ticket must be used. For multiple day tickets and membership passes, the validity period is intended to define the mandatory date for the first use and/or last use.

The system should allow the capacity for all type of ticket to be configurable. Capacity of a ticket can be configurable at multiple levels:
1) Sales Capacity: Allow only a fixed number of tickets to be sold (i.e. only 1000 tickets for an Eid day ticket). After the sales capacity has been reached, the system should automatically reopen systems In case of any cancellation or refund.
2) Admission Capacity: Allow tickets to be sold based on the capacity of the attraction (i.e. only 200 tickets to be sold per day for Ski Park).

The system should allow the number of entitled access per ticket to be configurable (N entries to Y access areas). Some tickets will allow only access once per attraction while some tickets will allow unlimited access for an attraction within the allow time period. The system should provide information on the remaining access for a ticket.

The system should allow configuration of properties for all type of tickets that define the behavior of the ticket. For example, an open-dated ticket can be available in different tiers such as normal admission, VIP admission or different age groups such as child, adult, senior.
The system should allow combination of multiple properties for all type of tickets. For example, there can be a VIP child ticket and a normal adult ticket.

The system should allow management of all types of resources:
- Areas with limited capacity (e.g. Meeting rooms, Cabanas, etc.)
- Staff (e.g. Ski School Instructors, etc.)
- Objects (e.g. Strollers, Towels, etc.)

The system should allow easy creation and tracking of resources, and link them to individual attraction experiences, so that a ticket is not only based on available time-slots but also on relevant resources.

The system should allow management of the schedules of the staff resources with the possibility to set the parameters such as total hours, breaks, leave plan, absences. This data can be captured via manual entry or through integration with another workforce management system.
The system should allow linking of staff resources in different combinations and time-slot capacity with individual attraction experiences such as group lessons and private lessons.
The system should allow selection of specific instructors, staff skillset and/or specific timeslots for the staff offering experiences.

The system should provide a calendar view for all the resources (e.g. instructors) and associated time slots (e.g. ski school session by an instructor). The calendar should support application of filters such as date range, time range, resource type and/or resource name. A resource timeslot should be selectable from the calendar view for purchase.

The system should show the booked capacity of different time-slots to provide their availability. The capacity can be color-coded to indicate if not busy, moderately busy, or crowded within each time-slot.
The system should allow check out & check in feature for rental resources. For example, towels in the water park. Inventory management of these resources should be handled in the system.
The system should allow configuration of deposit requirement for rental resources. The collection and return of the deposit at the time of check-in and check-out should be handled within the system.
The system should allow linking of a checked-out resource object to a guest profile. Specification of a rental time period for a checked-out resource object should be supported.

The system should be able to generate operational rosters for staff resources. The rosters should provide information on the staff resources associated with an attraction, their availability, booked timeslots and the tickets associated with them.
System should allow to assign the resources dynamically based on the resources availability and piority. The same functionality should be available over API / Online websites

Using the calendar view, system should provide an drag and drop interface to reassign the resources from one resource to another available resources. System should automatically assign the next resource in case if the assigned resource is not available
Ability to define resources required for each event along with the availability schedule. The resources could be of any type:
Venues & Spaces: Auditoriums, halls, rooms, stages, breakout areas.

Multi-language support.
Responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Customize cookie preferences.

Strictly Necessary - Required for website functionality
Functional - Enhances user experience

Enable/disable specific cookie categories.

Store:

Track:
- Initial consent

Generate audit reports for compliance reviews.

Automatic Cookie Scanning
Scan websites to detect cookies automatically.
Identify:
- New cookies
- Third-party cookies
- Tracking technologies
- Pixel tags
- Local storage items
Alert administrators when new cookies are detected.

Block non-essential cookies until consent is granted.
Prevent loading of:
- Analytics scripts

- Advertising trackers
Enable cookies only after user approval.

Manage cookie policy content centrally.
Version control for policy updates.
Publish updated policies automatically.
Maintain historical policy versions.

ePrivacy Directive

Centralized administration.

Dynamic QR Code Supports:
1. Registration: Customers select "Digital Ticket" via the confirmation page, email, or ticket PDF to begin the enrollment process.
2.Activation: After registration, the ticket appears as a blurred QR code in the App. It becomes clear and usable only when near park entrance beacons.
3.Anti-fraud: Each QR code is generated dynamically using six secure parameters (OTP, timestamp, private key, ticket ID, device ID, etc.) and is not stored or visible in advance. Screenshots of the QR code are invalid and cannot be used for entry. 
4.Offline Support: No internet connection is needed to display or validate the QR code.
5.Device Binding: Each ticket is linked to a specific device and user to prevent unauthorized duplication or access.
6.Ticket Transfer: Tickets can be transferred via email or app; recipients must log into the App to access and activate the QR code.
7.Usage Restrictions: QR code only activates on the day of the visit and near park gates to ensure secure, location-based access.
Unique Code per Ticket: Generate a unique QR code for every issued ticket or pass.
Dynamic Refresh: QR codes refresh periodically (e.g., every 30–60 seconds) to prevent screenshots or duplication.
The system shall immediately invalidate dynamic QR codes when tickets are refunded, cancelled, transferred, exchanged, upgraded, or re-issued.

Access control hardware supports:
1. Real-time verification of ticket validity and real-time deduction of ticket usage
2. The gate will display a green light and open if all of the following conditions are met:
1) The ticket is valid.
2) The verification method matches the one chosen by the customer
3) The ticket is not a physical personalized ticket, unless it is the first entry for a single-day, single-park ticket.
4) There are no segment restrictions on the ticket, or any applicable restriction has been verified (e.g., for a junior ticket with a 1.3m height limit, the hardware automatically confirms the customer's height, or auto face recognition on female limited tickets).
5) For re-entry tickets, the customer must use the designated re-entry gate.
3.The gate will display a yellow light, accompanied by sound and visual prompts to alert staff, in the following cases:
1) The verification method does not match the one selected by the customer.
2) It's a physical personalized ticket.
3) The ticket has crowd-specific restrictions (e.g., for persons with disabilities, POD accompanying persons, the elderly, or nannies) that cannot be automatically verified. 
After verification, staff may choose to manually open the gate.
4. Otherwise, the gate will display a red light and not open.
5. 'Free Spin' mode can be set, the gate does not read the ticket but counts the number of rotations

details:
1) Face Pass can only be registered through the App, ticket counters, or the Annual Pass counter. One facial profile may not be associated with more than one annual pass.
2) App Registration SOP:
Customers must log in to the App, provide consent, and then complete facial registration. For minors, consent must be provided by a guardian before facial data can be captured.
3) On-site Registration SOP:
Consent must be signed before facial data is recorded. For minors, the guardian must be present to sign the consent form and provide their email address for verification.
4) Modify:
Customers may re-register their facial data. However, the system automatically detects the similarity between the new and previous facial data. If the difference exceeds the acceptable threshold, the update will be blocked, and the customer must contact the venue for assistance.
5) Delete: Deletion of Face Pass can only be done through the App. If there is an active ticket that has already been verified with Face Pass, deletion is not allowed. Once deleted, any unused valid tickets should be verified with an alternative verification method. The biometric data will be permanently removed, but the consent record will be retained.

The system should allow accumulation of redemption tickets credits into guest's digital wallet through multiple ways:
- Ticket-based system: Integration with Ticket-eater machines to add the credits for the physical inserted redemption tickets
- Ticketless system: Integration with Redemption games to digitally load the credits for the redemption tickets after a guest has completed a game.
The system should provide the ability to view all the credits stored in a digital wallet at multiple kiosks; operator kiosks and self-service kiosks.

The system should allow usage of redemption tickets credits in the digital wallet at redemption counter for prizes. Prizes on redemption counter, skill games, direct pay machines (e.g. cranes) should be integrated with the inventory system.
The system should have the ability to add credits for free games and rides to the  digital wallet of a guest which can be used across applicable attractions.

The system should have ability to define multiple types of readers (minimum three).  The properties of the readers should be configurable:
- type of credit accepted at a reader
- amount of credit required for a reader
- attraction type linked to the reader
Through these properties, multiple combinations of readers can be created to support the business requirements. For example: one reader for Video games , one reader for Skill games and one reader for rides.

Realtime validation of Credit/card balance, bonus and entitlements before game starts
- Customers tap the card before playing the game and amount should be deducted based on the available balance and show the remaining balance
- Customer taps the card, and it should be allowed to play in case if the customer allowed to play specific game

Free games with color glow reader
-To show free games with a different color on the card reader, so that customer can understand all these games are free

Dynamic pricing for games
- System should provide an ability to set up peak / nonpeak pricing for all the games / rides based on specific date / time

Retry variable price
-This is applicable to skilled games where the customer plays a game, and before the game finishes, a pop-up appears with the question, ‘Do you want to continue?’ By Tapping the RFID card, it should deduct a lower price than the original amount, as this is a retry transaction

Normal & VIP price
- To have one reader to show both Normal Price & VIP Price for specific game.
- For VIP, customer buys VIP product. All the rides / games have specific prices assigned for Normal & VIP.

Retap delay (There should be a delay configured between the first tap to the second tap and so on)
- Customers tap the card to play a game. Customer retries immediately and it will deduct the money again. To avoid this scenario, there should be a delay to Retap after few seconds (5 seconds) and then customer will be able to tap the card

Custom theme for Readers
- Skilled Games should have one theme for the reader; Rides should have another theme. To be able to control from BOS.

Check balance
- There should be a reader to check the balance for the customer

Card expiry based on last recharge & last activity
- Any card issued should have expiry of 6 months based on the last card activity date or last recharge

Card Top + Bonus
- A customer can Top up of 100 AED should include (100 AED + 25 AED (Bonus))
- This Bonus allowed to play only Games / Rides (not allowed to redeem in F&B / Retail) Should be configurable
- Bonus to be used only in Amusement park rides / games
- No Refund allowed on the remaining balance
- Bonus cannot be refunded.
- There should be validity set for the Bonus.
- Option to provide additional Bonus to the customer on demand
